title: feat(core,vue): add onSelectionChange and onSlashMenuChange config callbacks
body:
## Summary

Add `onSelectionChange` and `onSlashMenuChange` config callbacks to `EditorConfig`,
mirroring the existing `onChange`/`onFocus`/`onBlur` pattern. Previously these
lifecycle events were only accessible via the event emitter.

| Package | Change |
|---|---|
| `core/types` | Add `onSelectionChange?` / `onSlashMenuChange?` to `EditorConfig` |
| `core/editor` | Wire callbacks alongside existing `emitter.emit` calls |
| `core/test/events.test` | 5 new tests |
| `vue/editor` | Expose as props + emits, bridge config callbacks to Vue events |
| `vue/test/editor-vue.test` | 2 new tests for Vue emit behavior |

## Test plan

- [x] 544/544 tests pass (7 new tests: 5 core + 2 vue)
- [x] Both config callback + event emitter paths verified
- [x] Backwards-compatible, no API breaks, no new deps
